decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system builds directly on the firm's core spraying know-how, and its own R&D lets it interpret early results and refine the system, so it remains on the market.

The low-pressure injection pump is close to the established offer, was field-tested on a construction site before launch, and has a page of its own, so the firm has the knowledge to assimilate feedback and improve it.
The multi-model transfer pump line reuses the proven WIWA air motors, a strong base of related knowledge that makes keeping and developing it straightforward.
Fire protection flow monitoring extends the firm's equipment expertise and has a page of its own, so its R&D and university cooperation give it enough related knowledge to learn from early results.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system was launched recently and sits close to the core spraying business, which the firm can readily interpret and improve.
